questions.stem_text: Name and describe four types of reliability.

options.A: Content validity, criterion validity, construct validity, face validity
options.B: Test-retest, internal consistency, inter-rater, content validity
options.C: Alternate form, inter-rater, construct validity, criterion-related validity

questions.stem_text:
According to Caplan's model of consultee-centered case consultation, the consultant is
primarily interested in

options.A: identifying the causes and solutions of the client's presenting problems
options.B: establishing a hierarchy of authority to enable effective decision making
options.C: ensuring the consultee adheres strictly to a predetermined action plan
options.D: proposing multiple alternative solutions for the consultee to choose from
options.E: identifying the strengths and weaknesses of the consultee's current approach

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - identifying the causes and solutions of the client's presenting problems

questions.stem_text: When using the Premack Principle to modify a behavior, the reinforcer is:

options.C: a specific reward given after the desired behavior.
options.D: a stimulus that is artificially created.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - a behavior that occurs frequently.

questions.stem_text:
Research comparing heterogeneous and homogeneous work groups has found that, in general,
heterogeneous groups:

options.A: are more creative but worse at decision-making.
options.B: are more creative and better at decision-making.
options.C: make better decisions but are less creative overall.
options.D: are less creative and less productive overall.
options.E: are more productive but worse at decision-making.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - are more creative and better at decision-making.
